privacy.title: Who we are
privacy.body: Protein Plate is a personal project by Bernardo Paulino. For any question about your data, write to bernardo.sobral7@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Account
privacy.body: To use the app you sign in with Google or Apple. We store your name and email. Sessions don't store your IP or browser, and Google and Apple tokens aren't kept (except Apple's, encrypted, so we can disconnect it when you delete your account).

privacy.title: Your plan
privacy.body: We store your daily goal, training intensity, meals (including before and after training), diet, the foods you like, your kitchen equipment and cooking time, your day and the recipes you save. We use this to personalise your day and recipes (performance of contract).

privacy.title: Health data
privacy.body: Your weight and your allergies and intolerances are health data. We only store them with your explicit consent, given at the end of the initial form, and only to work out your goal and exclude foods. You can withdraw consent at any time: type your goal manually and remove allergies in preferences, or delete your account.

privacy.title: AI recipes
privacy.body: To generate a recipe, we send the AI model (Anthropic) only the names of the chosen foods, the meal, time, servings, equipment and diet. We never send your name, email, weight or allergies (foods with allergens are simply not in the list).

privacy.title: Usage limits
privacy.body: To prevent abuse, we count recipes generated per day with a code derived from your account (HMAC with a key that changes daily). Counters are deleted after 2 days.

privacy.title: Where the data lives
privacy.body: On Cloudflare (D1 database in the European Union). We don't use third-party analytics or advertising cookies. The service owner has a protected admin panel for support and aggregate numbers; each person's weight and allergies never appear there.

privacy.title: Your rights
privacy.body: In Account you can export all your data (JSON), change your preferences and delete your account at any time. Deleting your account deletes your profile, preferences, day, saved recipes and sessions. Generated recipes have no owner and stay public via their link.

privacy.title: Age
privacy.body: You must be at least 16 to create an account.

terms.title: What it is
terms.body: Protein Plate helps you reach your protein goal with real food. It's free and needs an account (Google or Apple).

terms.title: Informação geral
terms.body: A informação é geral e não substitui um nutricionista ou médico. Se tens uma doença renal, estás grávida ou tens outra condição de saúde, fala com um profissional antes de aumentar a proteína.

terms.title: Números
terms.body: Os valores nutricionais vêm da Tabela da Composição de Alimentos do INSA. Enquanto a curadoria não estiver concluída, alguns valores são provisórios e estão assinalados.

terms.title: Receitas geradas por IA
terms.body: As receitas são geradas por IA e podem ter erros. A proteína é calculada pela app a partir da TCA. Confirma sempre alergénios, intolerâncias e tempos de cozedura.

terms.title: Utilização justa
terms.body: Há limites diários de receitas novas. Não uses a app de forma automatizada nem para sobrecarregar o serviço.

terms.title: Conta
terms.body: Podes apagar a conta quando quiseres. Podemos suspender contas usadas para abuso.
